name: Being silenced keeps the Witch Doctor's second ingredient (#13071)
contract: #13071 (Witch Doctor) reports that being silenced removes the second Cauldron ingredient, such as
Bloodthistle 801664, while the first ingredient, Jungle Shrooms 801660, stays. Mixologist 561069 tooltips
that you can add an additional ingredient to your Cauldron. The ingredients are permanent self auras
(SpellDuration 21 after the class contract) with no AuraInterruptFlags and no dispel type, so nothing in
Spell.dbc ties them to a silence. Expected: with Cauldron Brewer 92085 and Mixologist, brewing Jungle
Shrooms then Bloodthistle keeps both, and a hostile Silence (15487, 5 sec) neither removes either ingredient
while it lasts nor after it ends. This scenario reproduces the report.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: Mixologist keeps Jungle Shrooms beside it
A hostile caster silences the Witch Doctor
SETUP: the Witch Doctor is silenced
#13071: the silence keeps the second ingredient
#13071: the silence keeps the first ingredient
Let the Cauldron tick after the silence
#13071: the second ingredient survives the silence
#13071: the first ingredient survives the silence
